grade: CONJECTURED (conditional theorem; conditionality in the claim text)
named_conjecture:
PERIOD CONJECTURE FOR EXPONENTIAL MOTIVES (Fresan-Jossen; exponential analogue of the Grothendieck period conjecture).  STATEMENT: for an exponential motive M over a number field, the transcendence degree over Q of the algebra generated by the (exponential) periods of M equals the dimension of the exponential motivic Galois group of M:
        trdeg_Q < periods(M) >  =  dim G_mot(M).
Equivalently: every polynomial relation among the exponential periods of M is of motivic origin (induced by a morphism of exponential motives).
named_conjecture_locator: J. Fresan, P. Jossen, 'Exponential Motives', book in preparation (draft on the first author's webpage); the exponential period conjecture is the exponential analogue of Grothendieck's period conjecture [M. Kontsevich, D. Zagier, 'Periods', in Mathematics Unlimited -- 2001 and Beyond, Springer 2001, pp. 771-808; Y. Andre, 'Une introduction aux motifs', SMF Panoramas et Syntheses 17 (2004)]. (NOTE: an arXiv id returned by an AI search for this work was VERIFIED FALSE -- 1705.07173 is an unrelated physics paper -- so no arXiv number is cited here.)

H1.statement: kappa is an exponential period of the exponential motive M attached to the rank-2 connection H2 (realised constructively on the convergent Borel-2 transform Phi, order-4 L) -- the connection coefficient A_Phi = kappa.
H1.source: CC3-S6-CLOSE (cc3_s6_2_bridge, 2cc2f6fb) + CC3-S6-1 period matrix (cc3_s6_1_period_matrix, 56adcb10): A_Phi = kappa to 129 digits, witnesses 208/204.

H2.statement: the motivic Galois group G_mot(M) contains (the identity component matching) the DIFFERENTIAL Galois group G_Gal(H2) = SL2; in particular dim G_mot(M) >= 3.
H2.source: differential side: CC3-2-KOV (cc3_2_1_h2_classify, e71e915f) G_Gal(H2)=SL2 non-Liouvillian (exact Kovacic). Motivic identification: conjectural (differential-Galois subset/equal motivic-Galois, in the circle of Grothendieck-Katz / Andre / Nori comparison results).

H3.statement: the period conjecture for exponential motives (Fresan-Jossen): trdeg_Q <periods(M)> = dim G_mot(M).

H4.statement: period-count / non-degeneracy inputs: rank(H2)=2, dim H^1_dR(H2)=2, the connection is IRREDUCIBLE (SL2 Zariski-dense) and (tr M0, kappa) lies OFF the classical/algebraic PIII(D8) locus; kappa is the single non-trivial off-diagonal Stokes/period entry (not a diagonal normalisation factor).
H4.source: CC3-2-DIM (e71e915f) dim H^1_dR(H2)=2; CC3-3-LOCUS (cc3_3_1_locus, a6b8d588) off-locus, irreducible, tr M0 not algebraic deg<=8; CC3-2S2-2A (b1fea3ed) |tr M0|>>2 hyperbolic.

theorem_conditional: THEOREM (CONDITIONAL).  Assume (H1) kappa is an exponential period of M; (H2) dim G_mot(M) >= 3 via the SL2 differential Galois group; (H3) the period conjecture for exponential motives; (H4) the period-count / non-degeneracy inputs above.  Then the period algebra of M has transcendence degree dim G_mot(M) >= 3 over Q, and the non-degenerate off-diagonal period entry kappa of the irreducible rank-2 connection is NOT algebraic:  kappa  not in  Qbar  (kappa is transcendental).  Consequently the EBR-I/EBR-II connection coefficient C = kappa * sqrt(pi)/Gamma(4/3) is transcendental as well (the factor is an elementary Gamma-multiple).
strongest_licensed_form_note: STRONGEST LICENSED FORM (NOT rounded up): the conclusion 'kappa not in Qbar' is licensed ONLY under the full conjunction (H1&H2&H3&H4).  Dropping H2 to the bare differential-Galois statement still gives a non-trivial CONDITIONAL structure but NOT kappa not in Qbar (the period conjecture is about the MOTIVIC group).  The weaker unconditional residue that survives WITHOUT H3 is only: kappa is a non-classical exponential period off the algebraic PIII(D8) locus (STRUCTURAL+VERIFIED) -- which proves nothing about Qbar-membership.  We do NOT claim any unconditional transcendence.
unconditional_residue: kappa is a non-classical exponential period (STRUCTURAL, S6) lying OFF the algebraic PIII(D8) locus (VERIFIED, cc3-3-1); this is the ONLY unconditional statement and it says NOTHING about Qbar-membership.

G1.gap: H3 the period conjecture for exponential motives is OPEN (no proof exists).
G1.what_would_close_it: a proof of the Fresan-Jossen exponential period conjecture (or the single instance for M) -- far beyond current technology.

G2.gap: H2 the identification G_mot(M) ⊇ SL2 (motivic = differential Galois here) is conjectural; only the DIFFERENTIAL Galois group SL2 is computed (exact Kovacic).
G2.what_would_close_it: a comparison theorem placing G_Gal(H2)=SL2 inside G_mot(M) with matching dimension (Andre/Nori-type realisation for THIS exponential motive), or an independent computation of G_mot(M).

G3.gap: the step 'kappa is a non-degenerate entry => kappa specifically (not merely SOME period) is transcendental' uses irreducibility + off-locus genericity, not an entry-by-entry period-matrix non-degeneracy proof.
G3.what_would_close_it: a proof that no SL2-equivariant Qbar-linear relation isolates kappa into Qbar (e.g. an explicit period-matrix rank/non-vanishing argument for M).

G4.gap: H1 realises kappa as an exponential period CONSTRUCTIVELY/NUMERICALLY (Borel-side connection coefficient, 129 d) but M is not yet built as an OBJECT of the Fresan-Jossen category with verified Betti/de Rham realisation comparison.
G4.grade_of_gap: STRUCTURAL (constructive shadow); full motivic membership CONJECTURED
G4.what_would_close_it: construct M = (X, f) explicitly (a variety with regular function whose rapid-decay period is kappa) and verify the comparison isomorphism; the I0(2 sqrt z) exponential-period kernel (DLMF 10.9.19) is the seed.

G5.gap: the OKSO 'only algebraic PIII(D8) solutions are q=c sqrt(t)' fact and the finite-braid-orbit => algebraic-coordinates principle were used WITHOUT a direct monodromy-point comparison to the c sqrt(t) solutions.
G5.grade_of_gap: VERIFIED (structural characterisations) with a stated caveat
G5.what_would_close_it: compute the monodromy data of q=c sqrt(t) and confirm (tr M0,kappa) differs (a finite check), OR cite an explicit character-variety description of the PIII(D8) algebraic locus.

ceiling_final: Unconditional transcendence of C/kappa is NOT a deliverable of op:cc-3 at any grade. This conditional theorem IS the program's ceiling and says so. A closed form would argue ELEMENTARITY-in-extended-class; a null proves neither.
